verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents official command-line tools for DGX B200 (e.g., nvidia-smi for GPU power reporting, command-line health checks, BlueField-3 mode switching), which constitutes an official CLI, but these are hardware/system administration commands rather than an AI-native, agentic-workflow CLI aimed at AI developers building agents. Missing for 10: evidence of a CLI designed for AI-agent workflows, agent-oriented scripting/automation hooks, or independent confirmation of its use in AI-native pipelines.
